necessary_context.content: f is continuously differentiable and l_f1-smooth; g is continuously differentiable and l_g1-smooth; ||grad_y f(x,y)||<=l_f0 for every x and y. For every x, g(x,.) is mu_g-strongly convex with mu_g>0. g is twice continuously differentiable and its full Hessian is l_g2-Lipschitz jointly in (x,y).
